threat_event: Attacker on a hospital network exploits a vulnerability in fielded IP-4 pumps to change infusion settings or the drug library
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Semiannual IP-4 release cycle; 38% of pumps run firmware more than two releases old; 41 aged component vulnerabilities not assessed
existing_controls: Signed firmware and secure boot; mutual TLS; dose limits enforced on the pump; annual penetration test
treatment_plan: Quarterly IP-4 security maintenance release; adoption reporting to hospitals; clear the triage backlog
exposure_estimate_usd: $2M-$10M (field action, customer credits, litigation; product liability outside cyber policy)

threat_event: Attacker exploits a vulnerability in fielded VM-7 monitors to alter alarm limits or stop telemetry
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Quarterly maintenance release in place; device security events not collected centrally
existing_controls: Quarterly release cycle; signed firmware; secure boot; unique device certificates
treatment_plan: Forward VM-7 security events to the CCC; continue quarterly cycle

threat_event: A known exploited vulnerability in a third-party component of fielded firmware goes unassessed and is exploited
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 41 matched component vulnerabilities older than 90 days lack an exploitability assessment; KEV matching is weekly and manual
existing_controls: Automated SBOM matching; ISAO feeds
treatment_plan: Automate KEV matching daily; triage service levels (KEV 7 days, critical 30 days); add 1 product security engineer

threat_event: A researcher's report is mishandled and the vulnerability is disclosed publicly before a fix
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: CVD policy published; 1 of 14 reports acknowledged late; intake depends on the security@ mailbox
existing_controls: Published CVD policy; 3-business-day acknowledgment target; ISAO membership
treatment_plan: Move intake to the eQMS CVD queue with alerting; monthly CVD metrics to the VP QA/RA

threat_event: Ransomware spreads from the office network or the vendor VPN into plant OT and stops Lines 1 to 4 and the MES
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Line 1 and Line 3 share a flat OT segment; persistent vendor VPN; 11 unsupported test stations; no OT monitoring; MES backup on the same network
existing_controls: Office and OT firewall; allowlisting on 41 of 52 stations; EDR on IT endpoints
treatment_plan: Segment Line 1 and Line 3; replace the vendor VPN with brokered access; OT monitoring; offline MES backups; replace unsupported stations
exposure_estimate_usd: $800K-$3M (5 days to 3 weeks of disruption; retest and revalidation)

threat_event: Ransomware or intrusion in the CCC interrupts remote monitoring and pump programming for hospitals
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Standing all-tenant production access; failover takes 6 hours against a 2-hour RTO
existing_controls: Isolated write-once backups; MSSP monitoring; guardrails; phishing-resistant admin MFA
treatment_plan: Just-in-time access for the container platform; automated failover; quarterly failover tests

threat_event: PHI for many hospitals is exfiltrated from the CCC through a compromised engineer account or bulk export
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 9 engineers with standing all-tenant write access; no review of privileged activity or bulk exports
existing_controls: Phishing-resistant MFA for admins; egress alerts; encryption with company keys
treatment_plan: Just-in-time production access; weekly privileged activity review; quarterly access reviews
exposure_estimate_usd: $4M-$15M (notice support for up to 2.4 million patients through 290 hospitals; contract and regulatory exposure)

threat_event: A tenant isolation flaw lets one hospital's users see another hospital's patients
threat_source: Software flaw exploited by an authorized user
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Isolation enforced in application code; tested yearly
existing_controls: Row-level database policies; automated isolation tests in CI; annual penetration test
treatment_plan: Add isolation tests for every new API; include in the 2026-10 penetration test scope

threat_event: An attacker with pipeline access gets malicious firmware signed and distributed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Two-person signing in the HSM; 22 engineers hold administrator rights on build runners
existing_controls: HSM with two-person approval; reviewed merges; signed containers
treatment_plan: Remove standing runner administrator rights; reproducible build check before signing

threat_event: The factory provisioning server's issuing key is stolen and used to mint device certificates that impersonate devices
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Issuing intermediate key held in software on a plant server on the flat OT segment
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-07 provisioning server; SYS-01 device gateway
existing_controls: Root key offline in the HSM; certificates bound to serial numbers in the ERP
treatment_plan: Move the issuing key into the HSM with a network signing service; automate revocation

threat_event: A compromised developer account inserts malicious code into device or CCC source
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Phishing-resistant MFA on repositories; reviewed merges
existing_controls: Branch protection; MFA; code review
treatment_plan: Signed commits on release branches; alert on branch protection changes

threat_event: The signing keys cannot be recovered after an HSM failure or loss of the VM-5 laptop, so no fix can be signed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: HSM key recovery never tested; VM-5 legacy key on an offline laptop with one backup in the same safe
existing_controls: Documented HSM recovery procedure; laptop in a safe
treatment_plan: Key recovery exercise; move the VM-5 key into the HSM; split backup custody across two sites

threat_event: A per-hospital shared API key is extracted from one VM-5 and used to spoof telemetry or query that hospital's data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: VM-5 authenticates with a shared per-hospital key
existing_controls: TLS; per-hospital key rotation on request; anomaly rules on telemetry volume
treatment_plan: Rotate all VM-5 keys yearly; bind keys to gateway source addresses; plan replacement

threat_event: The VM-5 embedded operating system reaches end of support in 2027-06 while about 11,500 units remain in service
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No customer end-of-support notice; no compensating controls guide
regulatory_driver: FDA premarket guidance (2026-02-03) section VI.A labeling; FDA postmarket guidance (2016)
existing_controls: Support until 2028-12-31 announced for the product, but not for the component
treatment_plan: End-of-support notice and trade-in program; compensating controls guide; updated MDS2

threat_event: Hospitals do not install IP-4 fixes, so fixed vulnerabilities stay exploitable in the field
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Adoption not reported to hospitals; semiannual cycle
regulatory_driver: N31-33-R05 (524B(b)(2)(A)); FDA premarket guidance section V.A.6 (TPLC metrics)
existing_controls: Update service stages releases; field service can install by USB
treatment_plan: Per-hospital adoption reports; field service outreach at 60 days; TPLC metrics for all products
owner: Director of Customer Support and Field Service

threat_event: A cloud regional outage lasts longer than the CCC's 2-hour RTO
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Manual failover took 6 hours in 2025
existing_controls: Second region provisioned; infrastructure as code
treatment_plan: Automated failover; quarterly failover tests

threat_event: The CCC database is corrupted or deleted and cannot be restored within the RPO
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Point-in-time recovery and monthly restore tests in place
existing_controls: 5-minute log interval; write-once snapshots in the backup account; monthly restore tests
treatment_plan: Add a quarterly full-environment restore test

threat_event: Hospitals are notified late of a PHI breach in the CCC because BAA notice terms are not tracked
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 290 BAAs with different notice terms (some 5 days); no central register
existing_controls: Compliance and Privacy Officer reviews each BAA at signing
treatment_plan: BAA terms register with the shortest notice term per hospital; build into P08

threat_event: A cybersecurity-related malfunction is not evaluated for MDR or correction reporting, and FDA reports are late
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Complaint handlers not trained on product security signals; PSIRT and complaint process joined only in 2026
existing_controls: MDR and 806 procedures; VP QA/RA review
treatment_plan: Cybersecurity decision points in the MDR and 806 procedures; complaint handler training

threat_event: The line equipment vendor's persistent VPN is used as an entry point into plant OT
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Persistent VPN appliance with a shared account inside the Line 1 and Line 3 segment; no session approval or recording
existing_controls: Firewall between OT and office networks
treatment_plan: Remove the appliance; vendor access through the privileged access broker with approval and recording

threat_event: Device history records for up to a day of production are lost because the MES backup sits on the same OT network
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Nightly MES backup to a plant file server only; never test-restored
existing_controls: Nightly backup
treatment_plan: Hourly log shipping to the cloud backup account; quarterly restore tests

threat_event: An operator using a shared MES login changes test limits and nonconforming devices are released
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Shared operator logins; no MFA; no individual accountability
existing_controls: Supervisor sign-off on limit changes
treatment_plan: Badge-based individual login with PIN; limit changes need a second approver

threat_event: Malware exploits the unsupported operating system on 11 test stations
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 11 stations on an unsupported operating system; no EDR on stations
existing_controls: Application allowlisting on 41 of 52 stations; USB ports locked
treatment_plan: Allowlisting on all 52; replace the 11 stations with revalidation; isolate until replaced

threat_event: A test station script or configuration change is made without validation and devices ship in a nonconforming or insecure state
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Plant equipment changes follow a maintenance log with no security review or revalidation trigger (gap 12)
existing_controls: Maintenance log; final test
treatment_plan: Bring station software under design change control with cybersecurity impact review and revalidation

threat_event: A test station loads an unauthorized firmware image onto devices during production
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Stations pull released firmware; devices verify signatures (VM-7, IP-4)
existing_controls: Devices reject unsigned images; stations pull only from production object storage
treatment_plan: Station checks the release manifest hash and records it in the device history record

threat_event: Phishing compromises an engineering laptop and design files or unfixed vulnerability details are stolen
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 5.9% phishing click rate; broad PLM read access
existing_controls: EDR; MFA; phishing training
treatment_plan: Restrict embargoed vulnerability details to the PSIRT workspace; tighten PLM read roles

threat_event: A cloud administrator account is taken over and used to change guardrails or delete resources
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Phishing-resistant keys enforced; break-glass accounts not yet tested
existing_controls: Hardware keys; guardrails; write-once logs
treatment_plan: Quarterly break-glass tests; alert on guardrail changes

threat_event: A transferred or former employee keeps access to repositories, cloud roles, or shared plant logins
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Annual access reviews; 4 of 25 transfers kept prior roles; shared plant passwords not changed
existing_controls: Automated termination in the identity provider
treatment_plan: Quarterly access reviews; automated prior-role removal on transfer

threat_event: A subcontractor without a BAA exposes PHI from support cases
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 2 of 18 PHI subcontractors (call recording, field service scheduling) have no BAA
existing_controls: Vendor contracts with confidentiality terms
treatment_plan: Execute subcontractor BAAs or stop PHI flows; purchasing gate

threat_event: A critical software component supplier does not tell the company about a vulnerability in time
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 6 of 22 critical software suppliers have no vulnerability notification terms
existing_controls: SBOM matching against public sources
treatment_plan: Contract terms at renewal; annual supplier security review

threat_event: An attack on plant OT, the MES, or the build pipeline goes undetected because those systems send no logs to the SIEM
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: OT, MES, PLM, and build logs not collected; MSSP contract excludes OT
existing_controls: EDR on IT endpoints; firewall logs
treatment_plan: Onboard MES, provisioning server, build pipeline, and PLM logs; passive OT network monitoring; extend the MSSP contract

threat_event: A hurricane closes the Florida campus for several days
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single plant; distribution center on the same campus
existing_controls: Hurricane plan; CCC runs in the cloud; finished goods buffer; generator for the server room
treatment_plan: Pre-position 1 week of finished goods at a third-party logistics site before hurricane season

threat_event: AI-001 misses pressure injuries more often for patients with darker skin in postmarket use
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Postmarket subgroup monitoring lags; hospital outcome data arrive late
regulatory_driver: FDA De Novo special controls and labeling; predetermined change control plan
existing_controls: Premarket subgroup testing; nurse review of every image
treatment_plan: Quarterly subgroup monitoring from hospital outcome samples (P10)

threat_event: The AI-005 complaint summarization feature misses an MDR-reportable signal and a report is late
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Feature enabled 2026-05 without review; handlers may rely on its suggestion
existing_controls: Every complaint is still reviewed by a handler
treatment_plan: Suggestions hidden until the handler decides; monthly sample review; validation under QMS software procedures

threat_event: Engineers paste source code or embargoed vulnerability details into public AI assistants
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Public tools not blocked; enterprise assistant available
existing_controls: POL-05 prohibits it; enterprise assistant with no-training terms
treatment_plan: Block public AI domains on company devices; data loss prevention rule for code and advisory drafts

threat_event: An AI-003 optical inspection model update is not validated and defective boards pass inspection
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: AOI model updates not handled under the production software validation procedure
existing_controls: Board test after AOI catches most functional defects
treatment_plan: Validate each model update; lock the model version on the line

threat_event: The AI-002 alarm artifact reduction model suppresses a true alarm once released
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: In development; subgroup and edge-case testing not yet defined
existing_controls: Design controls; model never silences primary alarms in the current design
treatment_plan: Bias and edge-case test plan before design freeze (P10)

threat_event: FDA finds that section 524B postmarket processes are not maintained, in an inspection or the next submission review
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Triage backlog; TPLC metrics partial; VM-5 without SBOM
existing_controls: Documented plans in each submission; ISAO membership
treatment_plan: Close the P03 524B roadmap items before the AI-002 submission

threat_event: Hospitals misconfigure devices because customer security documentation is outdated
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: VM-5 disclosure statement from 2022; SBOMs only on request
existing_controls: Current disclosure statements for VM-7 and IP-4
treatment_plan: Update VM-5 disclosure statement; customer portal with SBOMs

threat_event: Missing configuration standards leave servers and plant systems with insecure settings
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No configuration or OT standards (gap 14)
existing_controls: Cloud guardrails; container image scanning
treatment_plan: Issue STD-01 and STD-04

threat_event: A denial-of-service attack makes the device gateway unavailable
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Provider protection and rate limits in place
existing_controls: Provider denial-of-service protection; web application firewall; devices buffer 72 hours
treatment_plan: Accepted: residual risk within appetite; reviewed yearly

threat_event: A combined incident (product vulnerability plus data breach) is handled inconsistently and a clock is missed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Corporate IR and PSIRT joined in writing only on 2026-09-17; no combined exercise
existing_controls: P08 runbooks approved; PSIRT procedure
treatment_plan: Combined tabletop 2026-11-12 with outside counsel; annual thereafter

threat_event: A stolen laptop exposes design files or support data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Full-disk encryption on all laptops
existing_controls: Full-disk encryption; remote wipe
treatment_plan: Accepted: encryption makes data unreadable; low residual risk

threat_event: Complaint, CVD, and correction records are not kept long enough to support FDA inspection or breach defense
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: CVD and PSIRT records not in the retention schedule
existing_controls: QMS retention for complaints and 806 records
treatment_plan: Add CVD and PSIRT records to the schedule (at least 6 years; 806.20 records 2 years beyond device life)

threat_event: A compromised open-source dependency enters a firmware or CCC build
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Internal mirror and composition analysis; no provenance verification
existing_controls: Internal mirror; software composition analysis; SBOM per build
treatment_plan: Verify package signatures and provenance where available; pin versions

threat_event: A compromised device is used as a pivot into a hospital network
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Devices expose limited services; hospitals control their networks
regulatory_driver: FDA premarket guidance (2026-02-03) section VI.A labeling
existing_controls: Hardening; customer security guide lists ports and segmentation advice
treatment_plan: Accepted: hospitals control segmentation; guidance published

threat_event: Business email compromise diverts a supplier payment
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Payment change requests handled by email
existing_controls: MFA; finance training
treatment_plan: Call-back verification for bank changes; dual approval over $50,000

threat_event: A cloud storage misconfiguration exposes images or firmware
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Guardrails block public access
existing_controls: Organization guardrails; posture monitoring
treatment_plan: Keep guardrails; add a monthly configuration review

threat_event: An attacker on a hospital network uses the IP-4 factory service mode, left enabled on pumps shipped since 2026-03, to change calibration or infusion parameters (found in P07 on 2026-08-19)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: A test station script change skipped the lock step; one factory credential on every affected pump; 1,140 pumps at 37 hospitals
regulatory_driver: N31-33-R05 (524B(b)(2)(B)); 21 CFR 806.10; FDA postmarket guidance (2016) section VII.B
existing_controls: Customer advisory sent 2026-09-11 with network restrictions; station script fixed 2026-08-21
treatment_plan: Out-of-cycle firmware that disables factory mode at first clinical boot (due 2026-10-16); CAPA on station change control; follow-up with hospitals until 95% installed

threat_event: The product security team of 4 cannot keep up during a major event or loses a key person
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Small team; triage backlog already exists
existing_controls: ISAO and outside PSIRT support retainer
treatment_plan: Accepted with the funded extra hire in R-003; reviewed at the 2027 risk assessment
